2608.07176.title: Representation-driven Endoscopic Visual Embedding Alignment for Latent Generation
2608.07176.paper_summary: Developing foundation generative models for endoscopy is limited by the gap between natural and clinical images and the computational cost of training large Diffusion Transformers. Although representation alignment has improved efficiency in general computer vision, its role within the highly specialized endoscopic image space remains unclear. We introduce REVEAL (Representation-driven Endoscopic Visual Embedding Alignment), the largest generative foundation model for endoscopy to date, trained on GastroNet-5M (GN-5M), a multicenter dataset of 5 million endoscopic frames. Instead of depending on out-of-domain priors, REVEAL employs encoders pretrained directly on the endoscopic distribution to align diffusion latents with domain-specific visual features, preserving fine textures and intricate anatomical structures. Beyond image generation, REVEAL also serves as a powerful feature extractor; in multiple benchmarks, it delivers performance that is competitive with, and in several cases exceeds, endoscopic foundation models such as EndoViT and Endo-FM, specifically tuned for classification tasks, while demonstrating strong representation robustness under realistic imaging corruptions. REVEAL produces high-fidelity images and maintains robust structural coherence in latent-space edits such as inpainting and outpainting. This high-capacity backbone lowers the computational threshold for building specialized clinical tools, offering an open, versatile foundation for conditional synthesis, segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection in future intelligent gastroenterology systems.
2608.07176.paper_summary_zh: 開發內視鏡的基礎生成模型受到自然圖像與臨床圖像之間差距以及訓練大型擴散Transformer的計算成本的限制。儘管表示對齊在一般計算機視覺中提高了效率，但其在高度專業化的內視鏡圖像空間中的作用仍不明確。我們介紹了REVEAL（基於表示的內視鏡視覺嵌入對齊），這是迄今為止最大的內視鏡生成基礎模型，訓練於GastroNet-5M（GN-5M），這是一個包含500萬個內視鏡幀的多中心數據集。REVEAL不依賴於域外先驗，而是使用直接在內視鏡分佈上預訓練的編碼器，將擴散潛變量與特定於領域的視覺特徵對齊，保留細緻的紋理和複雜的解剖結構。除了圖像生成，REVEAL還作為強大的特徵提取器；在多個基準測試中，其性能與專門針對分類任務調整的內視鏡基礎模型如EndoViT和Endo-FM相當，並在幾個案例中超越它們，同時在現實成像損壞下展示出強大的表示穩健性。REVEAL生成高保真度的圖像，並在潛在空間編輯如修補和外繪中保持穩健的結構一致性。這一高容量的骨幹降低了構建專業臨床工具的計算門檻，為未來智能胃腸病學系統中的條件合成、分割和域外檢測提供了一個開放且多功能的基礎。
